svg.desc: Three stacked rows showing how the cost compounds: the same sentence is about sixty characters in either language; UTF-8 makes Cyrillic two bytes per character, an exact and unavoidable doubling; and tokenization adds a further two to three times because English merges into whole words while Cyrillic stays near single letters. The resulting token multiplier then hits context, cost and latency simultaneously.

svg.text: Each step multiplies the one before it. Only the first is forced by the script.
